name: Psycho Frogo
detailed_description:
ABOUT

🐸 GO GO PSYCHO FROGO!

A cute yet precision-focused top-down 2D platformer where a speed-obsessed, hungry frog races against time! Master challenging levels, shave precious seconds off your runs, and unlock new levels based on speed and jump count. Collect hidden artefacts and unlock awesome new Frogo skins along the way!

DEMO - COMING SOON! (JUNE - NEXT FEST 2025)

I'm hard at work on the Psycho Frogo demo, aiming to launch it for June’s Steam Next Fest 2025!
📌 Wishlist now and stay tuned for updates!

FEATURES

⏱ Speed-Driven Gameplay – Completing levels is easy. Mastering them is the challenge! Improve your times and unlock new stages through skillful play.

🔌 Power-Up Strategy – Temporary boosts add an extra layer of depth and strategy to every run.

🕹 Retro-Infused Fun – Inspired by classic Amiga arcade games of the ‘90s!

🔓 Unlockables Galore – Over 12 Frogo skins to unlock through challenges, plus full Steam Achievement support!

🗿 Artefact Hunting – Discover 30+ hidden artefacts scattered across the levels.

FOR PLAYERS WHO LOVE

🎮 Speedrunning – Every second counts!

🕹 Arcade Challenges – A perfect blend of casual fun and rewarding difficulty.

🏆 Completionist Goals – Unlock everything and master every level!

🐸 Pick Up & Play – Easy to start, hard to put down!

⚡ GO GO PSYCHO FROGO! ⚡

WHAT TO DO!? Games

I'm Phil, a solo independent game dev from the North-East of England! Thank you for checking out my game.
